itemDisplayName: Create an Azure SQL Database with the free tier
description: Deploys an Azure SQL logical server with Microsoft Entra-only authentication, a firewall rule for one client IPv4 address, and a General Purpose serverless database using the free tier. The database pauses when its monthly free allowance is exhausted instead of enabling paid overages.
summary: Create a free tier Azure SQL database with passwordless administration and automatic pause at the monthly free limit.
